en: Illustrated postcard showing a smiling woman in rustic clothing and a blue headscarf, standing behind a simple wooden table laden with rectangular cakes or bread loaves. She holds one tray in both hands. Beside the table is a metal container filled with decorative twigs or dried grain. At the bottom, there is a handwritten-style greeting text and a small printed code "N:o 62/6". The illustration is signed with the initials "V.H".
